_comment: Tuning for build_kb.py entity-resolution stage. Everything here is optional overrides on top of the automatic pipeline (concept-map -> node_aliases -> gazetteer -> modifier-strip -> unresolved).
_strip_note: Removed only from the START or END of a surface string, then resolution is retried. These do NOT distinguish one ritual entity from another. Semantic modifiers (dewasa, anak, bayi, massal, utuh, pangentas, panglukatan, ...) are deliberately absent so subtypes stay separate.
_deictic_words_note: Batch H (2026-09-21, conersation.md item #29). Demonstrative/anaphoric pronouns (a subset of strip_modifiers) that, sitting at a surface's leading/trailing boundary, never contribute a genuine alternate name -- 'kelompok ini' ('this group'), 'rurub sinom tadi' ('that rurub sinom just mentioned') are the extractor picking up an anaphoric reference within one sentence, not a synonym a real user would type. build_kb.py's get_ent() now skips recording such a surface as an alias (resolution itself -- force_merge / strip-and-retry -- still routes it to the correct entity exactly as before; this only suppresses the bot-facing 'also known as' listing). Added after confirming the same shape recurs beyond item #29's own kelompok_paksa_mahayana: rurub_sinom already carried 'rurub sinom tadi' as an alias for the identical reason.

force_merge._note: surface string (lowercase) -> canonical id, applied before everything else. Use sparingly for cases the concept map misses.
force_merge._batchC_note: Batch C (2026-09-21, conersation.md items #10/#14/#15/#49): pabersihan_mati/upacara_ngelelet/upacara_melelet_pabersihan_mati/upacara_pabresihan_mati are one ritual stage under four extraction-fragmented surface names (all four Glosarium entries -- ngaben-merge-cleaned.txt lines 246/249/282/306 -- describe the identical second purification stage, aka Ngelelet/Melelet: kerik kuku + change to white clothing, sequenced after Pabersihan Hidup and before Tirtha Pangringkes). Merged onto pabersihan_mati (fullest existing definition, already carries alias 'ngelelet'). anget_angetan's DISEMBURKAN_SAAT edge and pengerikan_kuku_mutlak's DILAKUKAN_SAAT edge both already targeted 'upacara ngelelet'/'upacara "melelet" pabersihan mati' as their raw surface text, so this merge reroutes both automatically with no separate edit needed.
force_merge._batchF_note: Batch F (2026-09-21, conersation.md item #17): S271 ('adapun atiwa-tiwa yang tergolong dalam ngaben svasta adalah raçadana atau tirta yadnya pranawa... sedangkan tata pelaksanaannya sama dengan atiwa-tiwa asti vedana') says raçadana/tirta yadnya pranawa/svasta are ONE family (body unrecoverable, tirtha symbol substituted) whose PROCEDURE merely resembles Asti Vedana's (bones exhumed) -- not identity. 'tirta yadnya pranawa' was previously alias-table-merged into 'swasta', masking it as its own concept; this identity entry (checked before the alias table in Resolver.resolve(), same trick as the nistaning/madyaning/utamaning entries below) splits it back out so it can carry its own SAMA_DENGAN edges to ra_adana/swasta instead. 'toyo çarira' (S271's parenthetical for simbol tirtha, never its own concept) force-merges onto the existing simbol_tirtha node so it registers as a real alias instead of silently vanishing (its only mention was an ADALAH-LITERAL row too short to become a definition and not eligible as an attribute either). 'recadana atau swasta geni' was a stray duplicate entity created only because that compound Glosarium heading (line 201: 'Nama lain untuk Ngaben Svasta (Nywasta/Swastagni)...') never resolved to any existing id -- merged onto swasta, whose own definition was relation-sourced (S46) and had no competing Glosarium text, so this is a clean gain (an explicit corpus statement connecting Swasta to Ngaben Svasta), not a collision.
force_merge._batchE_note: Batch E (2026-09-21, conersation.md items #1/#23/#47): 'pangabenan pranawa' (Glosarium line 285) and 'pangabenan jenis pranawa' (Glosarium line 176) are the same concept under two fragmented Glosarium headings -- both definitions are near-verbatim restatements ('Jenis pe/angabenan yang dilaksanakan tanpa jenazah maupun tulang, cukup d(engan/iwakili oleh) lambang awak-awakan(ing) sawa yang dibuat dari air...'), and the source body text itself alternates between the two spellings for the same referent one paragraph apart (ngaben-merge-cleaned.txt lines 2265 'pangabenan Pranawa selalu dilakukan tanpa jenazah...' and 2271 'Supta Pranawa masih tergolong pangabenan jenis Pranawa'). Merged onto 'pangabenan jenis pranawa' (the fuller heading, and the id item #1 names as the target supta_pranawa's existing S2480 BAGIAN_DARI edge already correctly points at). 'sanghyang agni' force-merges onto the pre-existing 'hyang agni' entity (whose own definition already parenthesizes 'Sang Hyang Agni' as the same referent) -- the gazetteer lists 'sanghyang agni' as its own standalone ENTITAS_KEAGAMAAN term, so without this override a future extraction using that exact surface would silently mint a duplicate deity node instead of landing on the existing one; damar_kurung's S1136 definition ('sarana permohonan kepada sanghyang agni') already names it, so this also unblocks that edge (see relation_results_ngaben.normalized.json, real S1136).
force_merge._batchH_note: Batch H (2026-09-21, conersation.md items #13/#29, definition-only fixes). Two force_merge VALUES fixed to remove the same id_with_underscores-instead-of-spaced-name bug Batch A found and fixed on broader_overrides KEYS (see the *** 2026-09-21 correction *** paragraph on broader_overrides below) -- this time on the VALUE side, which becomes the entity's displayed 'name' verbatim (get_ent() sets e['name'] = canon straight from whichever force_merge value first creates the entity, never re-spaced): 'kelompok ini' used to point at the literal string 'kelompok_paksa_mahayana' (underscored), so the bot displayed the id itself as the name; now points at 'kelompok paksa mahayana' (slug() of both forms is identical, so the entity id itself -- kelompok_paksa_mahayana -- is unaffected, only the human-facing 'name' field). 'simbol dewi sri' and 'penggunaan anggapan' used to point at 'anggapan ani-ani atau ketam' (the Glosarium-heading spelling); repointed to 'anggapan (ani-ani atau ketam)' per item #13's explicit request for the parenthetical form the corpus's own body text uses (ngaben-merge-cleaned.txt lines 2866/3377: 'Anggapan (anai-anai atau ketam)' / "'anggapan' (ani-ani atau ketam)"), with a third new identity entry ('anggapan ani-ani atau ketam' -> 'anggapan (ani-ani atau ketam)') added so the base Glosarium-heading surface (relation_results_ngaben.normalized.json line ~8909) redirects to the same new display name too, regardless of which row processes first (slug() of the parenthesized form is confirmed identical to the id already in use, so no id/edge/broader-link changes needed anywhere else). NOTE found while here, NOT fixed (out of Batch H's explicit scope, flagged for a future near-dup batch): a separate bare 'anggapan' entity (id 'anggapan', gazetteer-resolved, def 'pisau khusus yang digunakan untuk memotong padi pada masa lalu') duplicates 'anggapan_ani_ani_atau_ketam' -- both cite the identical S3591 for their kesuburan/Dewi Sri content, textbook same-concept-two-surfaces fragmentation (same shape as pabersihan_mati/pangabenan_jenis_pranawa already merged in earlier batches), never named in conersation.md's 52 items. Likewise 'upacara_panebusan' (fixed here, item #13) vs the pre-existing 'panebusan' entity (fixed in Batch E) look like the same fragmentation shape one more time -- kept separate in this pass since #13 only asked for a definition fix, not a merge decision.
force_merge._tingkatan_ngaben_note: The 9 nistaning/madyaning/utamaning-<X> sub-tier surfaces below map to themselves (a no-op resolution) purely to WIN over normalization-ngaben.json's 'tingkatan_upacara_ngaben' concept-map bucket, which force-collapses all 9 of them (plus bare nista/madya/utama) down to just 3 canonical entities (Nista/Madya/Utama) -- force_merge is checked before the concept-map in Resolver.resolve(), so an identity entry here keeps each of the 9 as its own distinct entity instead. That concept-map collapse is left in place for the bare nista/madya/utama surfaces (still correctly landing on Nista/Madya/Utama) since those really are the same 3 entities regardless of surface spelling. Without this override, 'nistaning madya' (etc.) never got its own entity at all -- the automatic dependency-rule extractor produced zero relation rows for the source's one enumerating sentence per group (S1278/S1279/S1280 in Graphing/Results/Final/ner_results_ngaben/hybrid_ner_results.txt), so build_kb.py never even called get_ent() for these terms; see relation_results_ngaben.normalized.json's matching manual_addition rows (sentence_id 1275/1278/1279/1280/1490) for where they're introduced. 'tingkatan ngaben' is a separate, smaller fix: a plain alias so a user asking 'apa saja tingkatan ngaben' lands on the existing tingkatan_upacara entity instead of the unrelated fuzzy hits it produced before ('tingkatan upacara' and 'tingkatan ngaben' share only one of three words).
force_merge._batchI_note: Batch I (2026-09-21, conersation.md items #4/#11/#44/#48, last content batch). Item #4 ('ngaben_madya' doesn't exist): investigation found the nista/madya/utama x nista/madya/utama tingkatan-upacara grid this item's investigation note anticipated was ALREADY fully built and connected (tingkatan_upacara hub + nista/madya/utama + all 9 nistaning/madyaning/utamaning-<X> sub-tiers, all with correct broader links, all citing real pipeline sentence_ids S1275/S1278/S1279/S1280/S1490) -- confirmed via entities.json and relation_results_ngaben.normalized.json's existing 'manual_addition+tingkatan_ngaben_fix' tagged rows, a prior session's work predating this graph-fix plan's Batch A-H (not one of the lettered batches; likely done alongside the 2026-09 'expanded glossary' commits). No hub construction was needed here. What WAS still missing: a user literally typing 'ngaben madya' had no deterministic path to the 'madya' entity (fuzzy-match dependent) -- the four entries below are plain resolution-convenience aliases, same shape as the pre-existing 'tingkatan ngaben' -> 'tingkatan upacara' entry directly above. 'ngaben ngewangun' -> utama is real corpus terminology, not a made-up convenience form: ngaben-merge-cleaned.txt lines 2790/3627/3677 use 'Ngaben Ngewangun' interchangeably with 'Upacara Ngaben Utama' (e.g. line 3627: 'tingkat Upacara Ngaben Utama (Ngaben Ngewangun)'); none of these four sentences were ever assigned a pipeline sentence_id, so no relation_results_ngaben.normalized.json row was added for them -- they are resolver config, not graph edges, consistent with how the pre-existing 'tingkatan ngaben' alias above was handled. Items #11/#44/#48: 'kepercayaan setempat' fixed above (was 'upacara_mesulub', underscored -- same force_merge-VALUE-becomes-displayed-name bug Batch H fixed on 'kelompok ini'/'simbol dewi sri', now fixed here too); 'upacara meselub'/'upacara suluban' are the corpus's own alternate spellings for upacara_mesulub (ngaben-merge-cleaned.txt lines 3681/3684). 'ngwangun'/'ngeplugin' are corpus-confirmed alternate names for ngulapin, not synonyms I invented (line 1537: 'Upacara ini dinamakan juga Ngwangun... Dinamakan pula Ngeplugin...' -- both explicitly 'dinamakan juga'/'dinamakan pula' the same upacara). 'ngroras jenis kangsen' is ngangsen's own corpus-given alternate name (line 2348: 'diadakanlah upacara darurat selaku pengganti, bernama Ngangsen atau melaksanakan upacara Ngroras jenis Kangsen').

_keep_distinct_note: never collapse these into their head word via modifier-strip; they may still get a broader: <head> link.
_bad_definition_note: Sentence ids whose BERARTI/ADALAH relation gives a WRONG or context-free definition for the subject entity build_kb.py resolves it to -- mis-attributed subject/context, not just a weak one. S2003 actually describes 'wadah', not 'bade' (the subject it landed on); S2056 ('ciri paksa brahmanisme') is a near-meaningless fragment attached to 'patulangan'. build_kb.py skips these as a definition candidate so the bot doesn't present them as authoritative. Left null until a proper hand-authored Glosarium entry replaces them -- see Graphing/kb/glossary_draft_review_batch2.md.
_broader_overrides_note_batchI: Batch I (2026-09-21, conersation.md items #44/#48). 'pengulapan' -> ngulapin: pengulapan's own (pre-existing, glossary-sourced) definition already states it directly -- 'Sesajen kecil yang dihaturkan kepada jenazah sebagai bagian dari rangkaian upacara Ngulapin' (ngaben-merge-cleaned.txt line 287) -- same 'single-word child, own definition names an ungraphed parent' shape as the broader_overrides entries above (the automatic head-word heuristic never fires for a single-word surface). This is the item #44 fix: ngulapin was isolated only because nothing pointed AT it; pengulapan (an existing, already-connected entity: it has an incoming DIKENAL_SEBAGAI edge from sajen_kecil, real S1082) now supplies that inbound edge. 'ngangsen' -> ngerorasin: ngangsen's own corpus passage explicitly calls it 'upacara Ngroras jenis Kangsen' (ngaben-merge-cleaned.txt line 2348) -- one of the 'beberapa jenis' (several kinds) ngerorasin's own MEMILIKI attribute already says Atma Wedana/Ngroras has (real S2542); ngerorasin is the pre-existing hub entity for the whole Ngroras/Atma Wedana/Patileman family (see its aliases). This is the item #48 fix. Both items' 'leave isolated if nothing turns up' permission (explicit in the batch's task text) turned out not to be needed -- corpus search surfaced clear, direct, already-partially-graphed support for both.
_broader_overrides_note_batchH: Batch H (2026-09-21, conersation.md item #13) -- 'upacara panebusan' -> ngaben: the item's own explicit request ('i think this needs to be connected to the ngaben node'); same 'stage/variant of Ngaben' shape as the batchE cluster above, added via the same lever for consistency (see relation_results_ngaben.normalized.json out-of-band S900041 for this entity's separate definition-fix row).
_broader_overrides_note_batchE: Batch E (2026-09-21, conersation.md items #1/#3/#18/#24/#28/#36/#39/#52b) -- same 'stage/variant of Ngaben' shape as pabersihan_mati/tirta_yadnya_pranawa above (row 1 of the plan's mechanism table), and the same 'body part whose own definition names jenazah as a TAIL token the automatic head-word heuristic can't see' shape as kaki_jenazah/kepala_jenazah/tangan_jenazah above. 'pangabenan jenis pranawa' -> ngaben: its own name literally means 'a kind (jenis) of pengabenan' (Glosarium line 176). 'tarpana' -> ngaben: its own definition states 'Dalam konteks Ngaben, tarpana dilakukan oleh ida sang sadaka... sebagai bagian dari rangkaian upacara' (line 376, never assigned a pipeline sentence_id). 'ayaban upakara diuskamaligi' -> ngaben: its own definition states 'adalah salah satu tahapan upacara Ngaben' (line 312); see relation_results_ngaben.normalized.json's new manual_addition row (out-of-band S900018) for its separate MENGGUNAKAN edge to the distinct 'diuskamaligi' entity (checked as a near-dup candidate first -- diuskamaligi is the reusable purification offering ITEM itself, 'juga dipakai kembali pada upacara penyucian rumah'; ayaban_upakara_diuskamaligi is the Ngaben-specific ceremonial STAGE of presenting it -- different scope, kept as two entities connected by an edge, not merged). 'mapegat' -> ngaben: its own definition states 'tahapan dalam upacara Ngaben yang bermakna krusial...' (line 343). 'pengabenan tanpa tirtha pangentas' -> ngaben: its own definition describes an incomplete/invalid INSTANCE of 'upacara Pengabenan' (line 414), same is-a-subclassification shape as the nistaning/madyaning/utamaning tiers above. 'lengan jenazah' / 'jempol jari kaki' / 'kedua mata jenazah' -> jenazah: each entity's own Glosarium definition (lines 402/400/401 respectively) names jenazah as the body this part belongs to, same shape as kaki_jenazah/kepala_jenazah/tangan_jenazah above (jenazah is the TRAILING token of kedua_mata_jenazah/lengan_jenazah's surface, or absent from jempol_jari_kaki's surface entirely -- either way the automatic head-word heuristic only checks the LEADING token, so none of these three resolve without this override); kedua_mata_jenazah was found while researching item #50 (pecahan_kaca, already connected to kedua_mata_jenazah via a real pre-existing HIGH-confidence S3154 edge -- this override completes that chain's second hop, same shape as #24, added here rather than a separate batch since it was found mid-research on this batch's own item). jempol_jari_kaki also gets a distinct DIKENAL_SEBAGAI edge to itik_itik (out-of-band S900020) -- its own definition supports BOTH connections ('Kedua ibu jari kaki jenazah... disebut itik-itik'), resolving the item's own stated uncertainty ('jenazah, too, or itik itik') as an AND, not an OR. 'tingkatan bade atau wadah' -> bade: its own definition is entirely about bade/wadah's tier system (line 233; 'wadah' already resolves to bade via its existing alias).
_broader_overrides_note:
Manual is-a/part-of links the automatic multi-word-head heuristic in Resolver.resolve() can't derive -- it only spots a broader concept when a multi-word surface's head (leading) token IS the parent entity's name (e.g. 'bale adat' -> 'bale'); it never checks the TAIL token, so 'kaki jenazah'/'kepala jenazah'/etc. (parent word 'jenazah' is last, not first) fell through even though their own Glosarium definitions name 'jenazah' directly. Panca Maha Bhuta's five elements are single, lexically unrelated words, so without an override each kept 'broader: null' even though the corpus's own 'Konsep Panca Maha Bhuta' section explicitly lists them as its constituents -- confirmed live: pancamahabutha and 4 of its 5 elements had zero graph edges connecting them (the other, 'akasa'/'bayu', were only coincidentally linked via an unrelated 'lingga sarira pitara' node). 'pretiwi' (not 'pertiwi') is the canonical id -- the corpus's own gazetteer already used that spelling for a pre-existing thin entity; 'pertiwi' is force_merge'd onto it above rather than duplicated. The 2026-09-17 KG connectivity audit (92 of 477 nodes had zero edges) added the rest: galar/kawangen/kawangen-jeriji/jenazah/tirtha/lembu/singa clusters where a Glosarium entry's own definition text names an already-graphed parent concept the extractor never linked to (dropped subject/object -- see Graphing/flag.txt). Applied in resolve() after the automatic heuristic, so it always wins. nista/madya/utama -> tingkatan_upacara, and the 9 nistaning/madyaning/utamaning-<X> sub-tiers -> their group (nista/madya/utama), give the ngaben tingkat/classification hierarchy the same hub-plus-named-children shape as Panca Maha Bhuta -- see force_merge's _tingkatan_ngaben_note above for why these 12 needed a force_merge entry too, not just a broader link.

2026-09-18 graph-fix pass (conersation.md audit) added four more hub families, same Panca Maha Bhuta shape -- a family of glossary-block entities each independently naming the same missing (or incomplete) parent concept: tembaga/emas/perak/besi/logam_campuran -> panca_datu (panca_datu itself pre-existed with only 'waja' attached, via a plain BAGIAN_DARI relations.jsonl edge rather than broader -- left as-is rather than converted, so panca_datu now has one child reachable via a relation edge and five via broader; both render as real graph connectivity, just through different KB-internal levers, not worth a disruptive mechanism-migration for one pre-existing edge). dewa_brahma/dewa_iswara/dewa_mahadewa/dewa_wishnu/dewa_siwa -> panca_dewata (new hub; corpus sentence S1556 in relation_results_ngaben.normalized.json names this exact five-god membership -- 'panca dewata (içwara, brahma, mahadewa, wisnu dan siwa)' -- so this is corpus terminology, not an invented category). sthula_sarira/suksma_sarira/antah_karana_sarira -> tri_sarira (new hub). malamasa -> sasih (simple addition to the pre-existing sasih family, its own definition ('sasih yang ditampih atau diduakalikan' -- an intercalary/leap month) already says as much). priuk_tempat_tirtha_pangringkes/semua_alat_pangringkesan/tirta_pengeringkes/balai_balai_alas_ngringkes -> pangringkes (new hub for the corpse-wrapping-stage family). *** 2026-09-21 correction + completion of the above: the 2026-09-18 paragraph (still above, left for the audit trail) described these five hub families as fully 'added', but only this broader_overrides config had actually been written -- the hub entities themselves (panca_dewata, tri_sarira, pangringkes, bhuwana_agung) did not yet exist in entities.json (confirmed: absent from a fresh read), because no manual_addition row had ever created them, so their children's broader-link would have resolved to nothing at the next build. Also, the '9102'/'9103' out-of-band ids that paragraph named were never actually written anywhere in relation_results_ngaben.normalized.json. This pass (Batch A of the conersation.md graph-fix plan) added the missing creating rows, following the real out-of-band convention already established by Batch G (900001/900002, 'kg_connectivity_fix3'): panca_dewata's own ADALAH definition cites real S1556 (the passage naming all five gods as Panca Dewata); bhuwana_agung's own ADALAH definition cites real S1609 (the moksa passage naming Bhuwana Agung/Pancamahabutha); antah_karana_sarira's own ADALAH definition cites real S4338 (the tirtha pangentas passage naming it directly, hence the key fix above -- the corpus spells this term with a space, 'Antah Karana Sarira', at S4338 and in the source's own body text, not run together, so the id had to change to match how slug() would actually derive it from that surface); bhuwana_alit's existing glossary definition already states outright that it is 'pasangan dari bhuwana agung', so bhuwana_agung/bhuwana_alit are linked with a new manual_addition PASANGAN_DARI edge (not broader_overrides, since the corpus frames them as counterparts, not parent/child) citing that same glossary sentence out-of-band as S900003 (it never got a pipeline sentence_id, same situation Batch G hit for sasih at S900002). tri_sarira (S900004), suksma_sarira's definition fix (S900005, replacing the old thin 'materi (walaupun sangat halus)' one-line reading -- still real S2914, just too weak to serve as the entity's definition on its own), and sthula_sarira (S900006) draw on real corpus passages that also never received their own pipeline sentence_id: ngaben-merge-cleaned.txt's 'Lingga Sarira Pitara' Glosarium entry (line 158, names Tri Sarira directly) for tri_sarira and the suksma_sarira fix, and the 'Makna dan Tujuan Ngaben' section (line 525, 'Sthula Sarira ini berwujud sepuluh alat indrya...') for sthula_sarira -- both verified present verbatim in the source file. pangringkes's own ADALAH definition (S900007) cites the 'Setelah pelaksanaan eteh-eteh Pabersihan Mati... Upacara Pangringkesan atau upacara membungkus/menggulung jenazah' sentence (appears twice in the source, lines 3598 and 3965), also never picked up by the dependency-rule extractor. See relation_results_ngaben.normalized.json for all of these rows (tag 'manual_addition+kg_graph_fix_batchA'). *** Also re-examined while here: item #9's permata-vs-logam_campuran question (see the 2026-09-18 paragraph above). Found a THIRD corpus citation beyond the two the previous note weighed -- body text at ngaben-merge-cleaned.txt line 1863 ('Pada Sawa Wedana digunakanlah lima jenis pripih logam (perak, tembaga, emas, besi dan permata)...') -- which does give 'permata' real descriptive content (a pripih wrapped in daun dapdap, plugged into the corpse's mouth at masesalin). But re-reading besi's and emas's OWN Glosarium bullets (not just the god entries) shows they already self-consistently name 'logam campuran' as the fifth, independent of the five-god bullets -- so the 'logam campuran' side of this split now has 7 corroborating corpus mentions (besi, emas, and all five dewa_* bullets) against permata's 3 (tembaga, waja, the Sawa Wedana line). The previous decision (logam_campuran only, no permata, as panca_datu's fifth child) stands, now on firmer evidence. 'permata' likely still deserves its own standalone entity for its real Sawa Wedana content (mouth amulet, distinct from panca_datu membership) -- flagged as a candidate for a definition-only batch, not created in this pass. *** Also found and fixed while verifying this build: every multi-word broader_overrides key added in the 2026-09-18 pass (dewa_brahma, dewa_iswara, dewa_mahadewa, dewa_wishnu, dewa_siwa, sthula_sarira, suksma_sarira, logam_campuran, and the four pangringkes-family keys) was written in id_with_underscores form, but Resolver.resolve() checks membership with `canon in self.broader_overrides` where canon is the space-separated resolved NAME (e.g. 'dewa brahma'), never the underscored id -- so every one of these silently never matched and every one of those seven entities kept broader:null through the first rebuild of this session, even though panca_datu's single-word children (tembaga/emas/perak/besi, no space either way) worked fine and masked the bug. Rewrote all of them to space form (matching each entity's actual 'name' field exactly, incl. the hyphen in 'balai-balai alas ngringkes'); confirmed by rebuild that all seven now carry the correct broader link. The older sasih_kadasa-style entries above were already correctly space-form and did not need this fix.

NOT added here: a 'permata' entity for panca_datu's occasionally-cited fifth metal. tembaga's and waja's own glossary lines say '...emas, perak, besi, dan permata', but four OTHER cross-referenced entries (besi/emas/perak/dewa_siwa, each with a real direction+god citation) agree the fifth is 'logam campuran', and 'permata' has no standalone content anywhere in the corpus -- a bare word in two lists, nothing to hang a real definition on. Both phrasings are genuine corpus text (the source document has two overlapping glossary passes, not a KB extraction bug), so tembaga/waja's existing definitions were left untouched rather than 'corrected' -- only logam_campuran was added as panca_datu's fifth child. Flagged for the project owner's awareness, not silently resolved either way.
_exclude_note:
Entity ids the bot must never resolve a user query to or list under a type category -- generic/ambiguous words the extractor over-eagerly turned into standalone entities (see Graphing/kb/glossary_draft_review.md). 'manusia' is just the common word 'human' pulled from one philosophical sentence; 'badan' ('body') is used for 3 unrelated things in the source text (a philosophy term, a specific ritual effigy, and generic body) so no single merge target would be correct. 'ngroras' is a near-empty duplicate of the now-well-defined 'ngerorasin' -- excluded here (not just force_merge'd) because its own name would otherwise exact-match before force_merge is ever consulted (exact-match is checked first in kb_resolver.resolve()); excluding it from the surface map lets the 'ngroras' -> 'ngerorasin' force_merge entry actually fire.
